journey.name: Send a saved draft and refresh the page that follows
journey.description: Start: the Mailflare v2 inbox is open and signed in, online, and no message with the subject "Draft send journey" exists in Drafts or Sent. A draft opened from Drafts has its own address. Once it is sent the draft is gone, so the page shown afterwards must have an address that still exists: refreshing it must show that page, not "Not found".

actions.action: Tap the round compose button with the pencil icon at the bottom right of the screen
Tap the "To" field, type "maya" and tap the "Maya Chen" suggestion
Type "Draft send journey" into the "Subject" field
Verify that the composer reads "Saved" within a few seconds
Tap the "Save and close" button with the X icon at the top right of the composer
Verify that the composer closes and the inbox is shown
Tap the menu button at the top left of the screen and tap "Drafts" in the drawer
Tap the draft with the subject "Draft send journey"
Verify that the draft opens in a composer filling the screen, with "Draft send journey" in the "Subject" field and a recipient chip for maya@acme.test in the "To" field
Verify that the "Send" button is visible on the screen and not covered by the keyboard; hide the keyboard with the Back button if it is covered
Verify that the composer closes and a message reading "Message sent." appears near the bottom of the screen
Verify that the Drafts list is shown with the "Drafts" heading, that the page's address is the Drafts list and no longer the draft's, and that "Draft send journey" is not listed
Swipe slowly downwards starting near the top of the list, ending near the middle of the screen
Verify that a refresh indicator appears at the top of the list, or that the list has refreshed
Verify that the Drafts list is still shown with the "Drafts" heading, and that no "Not found" page, error message or browser error page is shown
Tap the menu button at the top left of the screen and tap "Sent" in the drawer
Verify that exactly one conversation with the subject "Draft send journey" is listed in Sent
